title: Task-level help does not establish role replacement
text: The supplied Cybernetic Teammate research note reports a randomised product-innovation exercise in which AI-assisted individuals could perform comparably to unassisted teams on assessed ideas. This is a useful example of testing work quality rather than counting usage, while preserving the boundary between an exercise and sustained organisational performance.
qualification: Original study not retrieved here. Working-paper and journal versions differ; no numerical effects are reproduced. The exercise does not establish implementation value or permanent expertise.
